Using inclusive counting:

- Multiples of 13: \(\left\lfloor\frac{999999}{13}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac{99999}{13}\right\rfloor=76923-7692=69231\)
- Multiples of 17: \(\left\lfloor\frac{999999}{17}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac{99999}{17}\right\rfloor=58823-5882=52941\)
- Multiples of both \(13\) and \(17\) (i.e. \(221\)): \(4072\)

Thus:
\[
a=69231-4072=65159,\qquad b=52941-4072=48869
\]
\[
a-b=65159-48869=16290
\]

\[
\boxed{16290}
\]
